articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally turned GitHub into their personal confessional, dumping AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets for the world to see. The agency tasked with protecting America's cyber infrastructure just got schooled in OPSEC 101.

articles.title: Snowflake buys Natoma to help freeze out rogue agents
articles.summary: Disgruntled bug hunter threatens 'bone shattering drop' of six zero-days after Microsoft apparently hurt their feelings. When coordinated disclosure goes full scorched earth, we all win.

articles.title: Threat Actors Exploit Critical FortiClient EMS Flaw to Deploy Credential Stealer
articles.summary: Critical RCE in Gogs Git service lets any authenticated user execute arbitrary code with a beautiful 9.4 CVSS score. Self-hosted doesn't mean self-secured, apparently.

articles.title: ThreatsDay Bulletin: Claude Security Plugin, Azure Priv-Esc, Kali365 MFA Bypass, FIFA Scams +15 More
articles.summary: Microsoft throws tantrum over public zero-day disclosures while simultaneously nuking researcher GitHub accounts. Peak corporate hypocrisy: demanding responsible disclosure while being irresponsible custodians.

articles.title: More License Plate Reader Mission Creep: School Residency Verification, Background Checks, and Noise Complaints
articles.summary: Age verification laws are creating a privacy apocalypse for everyone, not just kids. EFF sounds the alarm as lawmakers rush to break the internet in the name of 'protecting children.'

articles.title: 🔒 A Win for Encrypted Messaging | EFFector 38.10
articles.summary: License plate readers have gone full mission creep—now they're checking school residency and handling noise complaints. Because nothing says 'serving and protecting' like automated surveillance for paperwork violations.

articles.title: Disgruntled 0-day hunter 'humiliated' by Microsoft pledges 'bone shattering drop' as Redmond calls cops
articles.summary: Military smartphones leaked troop locations to foreign adversaries through commercial tracking data. Turns out Candy Crush achievements aren't worth compromising national security.

articles.title: Microsoft Slams Public Zero-Day Disclosures Amid GitHub Researcher Account Removal
articles.summary: Attackers exploit critical FortiClient EMS flaw to deploy credential stealers via trusted endpoint management. When your security infrastructure becomes the attack vector, you're doing cybersecurity wrong.

articles.title: Critical Gogs RCE Vulnerability Lets Any Authenticated User Execute Arbitrary Code
articles.summary: ShinyHunters made off with 6 million Carnival customer records in April, because apparently cruise ship security is as watertight as their hull integrity. Another notch in the ransomware crew's belt.

articles.title: TrendAI™ is recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Protection Platforms
articles.summary: Researchers deploy multi-agent LLM systems for automated vulnerability discovery as CVEs hit 50K in 2025. AI vs AI—the future of cybersecurity is robots finding bugs other robots created.
